{{cv|DF2012|Steals food}}
{{vercat|DF2012|Steals food|Creatures by attribute}}
'''Shearable''' tame creatures (those with the SHEARABLE_TISSUE_LAYER [[Creature token#S|creature token]]) can be [[shearer|sheared]] to produce [[wool]] (without harming the creature itself). Only mature creatures may be sheared, and previously sheared creatures may not be sheared again until their wool has regrown.
